name: chromatic-foil-edge
title: Chromatic Foil Edge
description: A narrow spectral edge that appears on deliberate hover or keyboard focus without animating the whole surface.

accessibility.notes: Focus-within receives the same visible edge immediately; hover uses a short ease-out, and reduced motion preserves the boundary without a transition.

performance.budget: One masked pseudo-element with bounded opacity and scale transitions; no background-position animation or loop.
